verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting (Docker/Kubernetes, on-premise, private cloud) combined with the self-hosted MCP server lets an AI-native user spin up an isolated instance for testing without touching a production/cloud account — verified by a runtime probe showing a real self-hosted instance and MCP handshake booting successfully. However, this is a general self-host capability, not a purpose-built 'sandbox mode,' and community reports note instability/crashes when self-hosting under load, which undercuts confidence in using it as a reliable test environment. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging feature or documented seed/test-data workflow, and independent confirmation that self-hosted instances are stable enough for repeated automated testing.
